description: Get current UK used-car asking-price guidance from live dealer listings on Autoza — typical (median), lowest and highest asking price, optionally narrowed to a make or model. Where too few cars match to give a fair figure it says so instead of answering. Cars unless vehicle_type asks for vans, motorcycles or other stock. Prices are GBP and reflect what dealers are asking right now, not trade or valuation estimates. Use to answer "what do X cost used in the UK" or to sanity-check whether an advertised price is reasonable.

vehicle_type.description: Vehicle type. Defaults to "car". Results are filtered on the vehicle type each listing is recorded under. Pass "van", "motorcycle", "motorhome", "truck" or "caravan" for other stock.

name: get_uk_price_guide

_note.description: Where the figures come from: Autoza, prices in GBP, distances in miles.

available.description: False, with a message, when too few cars match to give a fair figure. Absent when a figure is given.

title: Get UK asking-price guide
